description: Use to see where a model (or make, or all cars) is cheapest or dearest across Irish counties, relative to the national median. Small counties may have few listings. Use market_stats instead when county comparison is not needed. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

country.description: Market to query: IE = Ireland (default), GB = UK including Northern Ireland, ALL = both. Prices are always also given in EUR (GBP converted at the live ECB rate).

title: Used-car prices by Irish county
